description: nhflow_2d_si_tidal_flat_tracers with density (A 620 1): salt and temperature fronts drive the flow, with wetting and drying, k-epsilon and the Thatcher-Harleman boundary. The tracer mass changes by the boundary inflow only (both parts of the split step add up), and the clipped mass stays at round-off.
covers: the split tracer step with open boundaries and drying columns (WL* of the old transport)
the pressure gradient next to dry cells
